method: Original four stems rendered with production native Web Audio factories at default blend/output gain, without shared limiter. Full old/new seven songs plus Human Fly Dub and an ordinary-return null comparison. Windows matched to pre-separation premix, using the previously established 1105/44100s alignment. Metrics measure signal differences, not a naturalness or enjoyment score.
limits: Room is an intentional remix treatment; adding it does not improve source separation or certify reconstruction of the original room.
The deeper candidate changed the attack/tail envelope more, and was rejected. Moderate treatment is a production judgement pending owner listening.
No original multitracks exist. Original playback/mastering, direct part levels/EQ, AI score/bank, and Dub arrangement/echo remain unchanged.
A part mute clears the shared room history too, so another part may briefly lose its earlier reverb while its direct audio continues.
Browser tests are not a real iPhone, Bluetooth or human listening pass.
